## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance optimization (allocation reduction, latency improvements)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the coding style and conventions of this project.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally (`dotnet test`).
- [ ] The Rust benchmark tool builds and runs without errors (`cargo check`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
